# Proposed Mutation

## Purpose
Describe the smallest intended change and why it is needed.

## Work Box / Issue
Link the governing issue or explain why no issue is required.

## Truth domain affected
- [ ] Architectural
- [ ] Implementation
- [ ] Evidentiary
- [ ] Operational organization only

## Invariants / contracts affected
List protected invariants and BehavioralContract references, or state `none` with justification.

## Evidence / provenance
List evidence, source material, tests, or references supporting consequential claims.

## Uncertainty
State known unknowns, assumptions, unresolved contradictions, and unobservable conditions.

## Reversibility
- [ ] Reversible
- [ ] Compensatable
- [ ] Irreversible

Explain rollback/rejection condition.

## Gauntlet impact
- [ ] No Gauntlet relevance
- [ ] Existing scenario should run
- [ ] New Gauntlet candidate may be required
- [ ] Independent test repository change required

## Verification
State how this change will be verified. Execution alone is not success.

## Promotion boundary
- [ ] This does not claim architectural promotion
- [ ] Promotion review is separately required

Successful implementation or testing does not by itself create architectural authority.
